# Validation rules

224 rules: 211 errors and 13 warnings. 157 of the 223 CEN EN 16931 rules are applied; the others are listed at the end with the reason.

## How to read this

- **error** blocks sending; **warning** is shown but does not block.
- **auto-fix** marks pure formatting fixes that cannot change the meaning (spaces, dots, date format, decimal comma). An auto-fixable issue hides the other issues on the same path: once the fix is applied, validation runs again and shows what is left.
- The message column is the French text shown to the user (packages/shared/i18n/fr.json); `{value}`, `{field}`, `{rate}`, `{category}`, `{mention}` and `{last}` are filled in per issue.
- Some rules read the context given by the caller, not the invoice alone: today in Europe/Paris (BR-FR-CO-01), the invoices already issued (BR-FR-CO-02, FF-NUM-01, FF-NUM-02, FF-CN-01; silent when the history is unknown), the seller option for VAT on debits (FF-DEB-01) and customer settings (FF-PO-01 purchase order required, BR-FR-14 delivers elsewhere, DGFIP-G2.32 public entity).
- BR-FR-DEC-01 runs while reading an XML file: the model holds cents and cannot represent a third decimal.
- Every rule has at least one failing case in fixtures/invalid and passes on the golden invoices in fixtures/golden (packages/core/src/rules/rules.test.ts).

## EN 16931 (CEN validation artefacts 1.3.17)

Mandatory fields, calculations (BR-CO), VAT categories (BR-S/Z/E/AE/IC/G/O) and code lists (BR-CL). Semantics and tolerances follow the CEN XSLT, including the "less than one currency unit" tolerance of BR-CO-17, BR-S-08 and BR-S-09.

## French CIUS (AFNOR XP Z12-012, BR-FR)

Rules of the French specification for the 2026 reform. Sources and dates: docs/research/FR_RULES.md.

35 rules.

| Id | Level | Scope | BT | Checks | Message |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| BR-FR-02 | error | document | BT-1, BT-25 | The invoice number and preceding invoice numbers only use A-Z a-z 0-9 - + _ / (no space). | Le numéro contient un caractère refusé (espace, point, accent ou autre signe). |
| BR-FR-03 | error | document | BT-2, BT-7, BT-9, BT-26, BT-72, BT-73, BT-74 | Every date has a year between 2000 and 2099. | L'année de la {field} semble fausse. |
| BR-FR-CO-01 | error | document | BT-2 | The issue date is not in the future (Europe/Paris). | La date de la facture est dans le futur. |
| BR-FR-04 | error | document | BT-3 | The type code is one the French CIUS accepts (380, 381, 384, 386…). | Ce type de document ({value}) n'est pas accepté. |
| BR-FR-CO-02 | error | document | BT-1, BT-2, BT-30 | The number was not already used this year by the same seller (local history). | Vous avez déjà émis une facture avec ce numéro cette année. |
| BR-FR-05 | error | notes | BT-21, BT-22 | Notes PMT (40 € recovery indemnity), PMD (late-payment penalties) and AAB (early-payment discount) are present. | La mention de l'indemnité forfaitaire de 40 € pour frais de recouvrement manque.<br>Le taux des pénalités de retard n'est pas indiqué.<br>La mention sur l'escompte manque, même si vous n'en accordez pas. |
| BR-FR-06 | error | notes | BT-21 | Notes PMD, PMT, AAB and TXD appear at most once each. | La mention « {mention} » apparaît plusieurs fois. |

| BR-FR-08 | error | document | BT-23 | The billing frame (goods, services or both) is present and in the list B1…M9. | Vous n'avez pas indiqué si cette facture concerne des biens, des services ou les deux. |
| BR-FR-10 | error | seller | BT-30 | The seller SIREN (scheme 0002) is present and has 9 digits. | Votre numéro SIREN manque ou n'a pas 9 chiffres. |
| BR-FR-11 | error | buyer | BT-47 | For a buyer established in France, the buyer SIREN (scheme 0002) is present and has 9 digits. | Le SIREN de votre client manque. Il doit figurer sur vos factures depuis le 1er septembre 2026. |

| BR-FR-13 | error | seller | BT-34 | The seller electronic address is present. | Votre propre adresse de réception électronique manque. |

| Id | Level | Scope | BT | Checks | Message |

| DGFIP-G1.41 | error | vat | BT-120, BT-121 | An exempt (E) VAT breakdown has both the exemption code and the text, except on 384 and invoices under 150 €. | Pour une exonération de TVA, le code du motif et sa phrase doivent figurer tous les deux. |
| DGFIP-G2.32 | warning | vat | BT-118, BT-121 | An invoice with only category O, or only E with a VATEX-FR-CGI261… code, is outside B2B e-invoicing. | Cette facture ne contient que des opérations sans TVA : l'administration ne la traitera pas comme une facture électronique entre entreprises. |

## Facture Impec checks (FF)

Our own checks: legal mentions of the Commercial Code, identifier keys (Luhn, VAT key, IBAN), numbering, formatting that can be fixed automatically, the line amount (FF-LINE-CALC, which CEN does not check) and sanity checks.

BR-CL-17 and BR-CL-18 cover the same values in both syntaxes but split them differently: CEN checks VAT breakdown categories under BR-CL-17 in UBL and under BR-CL-18 in CII. Here BR-CL-17 covers document allowances and charges, BR-CL-18 lines and the VAT breakdown; the oracle tests treat the two ids as one.
